decision.explanation: The provided evidence (pmid-28424201:f01) describes a study on cetuximab resistance in colorectal cancer involving PIK3CA mutations. This is mechanistically and clinically distinct from the claim regarding FLT3 D835Y-mediated resistance to Gilteritinib in benign neoplasm. The evidence does not support the claim.

citations.quote: A cohort of 32 colorectal cancer patients with acquired resistance to cetuximab (PFS > 12 weeks) was analyzed for resistance mutations using targeted deep sequencing of ctDNA. One patient had the PIK3CA p.V955G mutation. Cell viability studies of DiFi cells transfected with this PIK3CA variant confirmed resistance.

unresolved: No evidence found linking FLT3 D835Y to Gilteritinib resistance in benign neoplasm.
